meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Twenty-five minutes ago I was in a deposition, and I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste either of our time, Hale. My son found out he got a zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. I'm writing that down. Now tell me on what basis you gave it, and whether anyone asked Owen first.

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
Show me. Turn the screen. Owen told me he wrote it over the weekend, so before I read one more number, tell me whether that history can show text pasted in from somewhere else he'd been writing.
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
I'm searching it. Who else has seen this, Hale, and is anything on his record right now? Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.

Thursday at 8:15, in your room, no other students in it and nobody in his class told why. I'll agree to that to put this behind him, Hale, not because he did anything. I want it in an email tonight that the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on file, and the vice-principal gets a copy.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed that Owen will complete a supervised rewrite in your room on Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising, and that if it holds up the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I still require that rewrite to be private, with no other students present and nobody in his class told why, and I require a written promise that nothing goes on his file. I expect that confirmation from you in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 with a written promise that nothing goes on Owen's record.
What moved her: the dated version history and the quoted line that isn't in Hamlet, after you owned entering the zero before calling home.
